pages.text: [#](53341a)The curse can pass from an infectious Wolfman. To draw one naturally, leave an open Wolftrap beside a Wolf Altar, leash a sheep within eight blocks, and wait for a full-moon night. Once the trap catches it, even one bite can infect a player.[#]()
pages.title: Lycanthropy

pages.text: [#](53341a)Full-moon nights force the four-legged wolf shape unless a carried Moon Charm or a strong enough active Wolfsbane effect holds your current form.[#]()

[#](53341a)The altar advances ten levels. At level 1 offer 3 Gold Ingots; at level 2 offer 30 Raw Mutton; at level 3 offer 10 Tongues of Dog. At level 4 take its Horn of the Hunt, sound it, defeat the Horned Huntsman, and return.[#]()
pages.title: The Wolf Altar

pages.text: [#](53341a)Return before each trial. Pounce-kill 10 hostiles while airborne; howl by night in 16 distinct chunks; tame 6 wild adult wolves in wolf form; kill 30 Zombified Piglins in wolfman form; then kill a villager or player in either beast shape.[#]()
pages.title: The Five Trials

pages.text: [#](53341a)Level 2 grants Moon Charm control. Use it normally to switch wolf and human; from level 5, sneak-use selects wolfman. Wolf form digs soft ground and may find bones from level 3. Either shape feeds from living kills at level 4.[#]()
pages.title: Forms and Gifts

pages.text: [#](53341a)At level 7 a wolfman howl paralyses nearby non-werewolves and non-vampires. At level 8 a wolf howl calls a temporary tamed pack. Level 9 wolfman claws rend armor, and a level-10 bite may spread the curse to a near-death player or villager.[#]()

[#](53341a)A Were Villager keeps its profession, trades, name, equipment, and village identity through reversion or cure. Vampire-werewolf hybrids are disabled by default unless the server enables them.[#]()
